First, we broke geographical boundaries.

Then, we hacked national boundaries.

Now we're hacking physical boundaries.

Money isn't physical. It's all in the mind. Crypto is the ultimate money. Purely, mathematically, provable. Unbounded by matter or mind. #unbounded
